title: Dropdown
summary: Accessible single or multiple selection control with searchable options and optional portal projection.

template.description: Template variant name for SfBaseElement external templates.

root-class.description: Classes added to the root element the component draws.

root-style.description: Inline style declarations set on the root element the component draws, custom properties included.

appearance.description: How the field looks: bordered (the default, the field look of every field, FM-9) or filled. outlined, the former name of bordered, draws the same until 2027-01-01 (a dated alias, SF.deprecations).

columns.description: How many options a row holds in the grid layout. Ignored in a list.

error-message.description: The text shown under the field while it is invalid, in the error colour, in the field-message style; it is the trigger's error message for assistive technology (aria-describedby, aria-errormessage).

invalid.description: Marks the choice as wrong: the error border (filled: the error fill), aria-invalid on the trigger and error-message under the field. No error icon is drawn.

hint.description: The help line under the field, as sf-input's hint (field parity): the hint's ink, a step below the value, and the trigger's description (aria-describedby); on an error the error message takes its place.

help.description: The explanation behind a «?» (sf-help-mark, C133's look) after the label text (C153 (8)): a step below the value as the label; the label row keeps its height. The mark is named by its subject («Подробнее: <label>»). Empty: no mark.

layout.description: How the options are laid out. A list is one option a row; a grid puts several in a row, which is the only way a hundred glyphs can be looked at -- a column of them is a column nobody scrolls to the end of. In a grid an option shows its picture and keeps its text as the name a search reads and a pointer sees.

multiple.description: Allow several values while preserving their serialized selection order. Tag mode is multiple by default.

name.description: Native form field name for the selected machine value.

placeholder.description: What the field reads while nothing is chosen. Empty: the text of the page's language ("Not selected" in English, «Не выбрано» in Russian). Nothing is chosen for the person: the value stays empty until they pick.

portal.description: Anchor the popup with the shared Framework positioning (SF.Position): native top layer, flip, shift and viewport-limited height. On by default; portal="false" keeps the in-flow list.

search-placeholder.description: Empty: the text of the page's language ("Search" in English).

size.description: The step of the field ladder, as sf-input's (1/3, 1/2, 1, 2, 3): the field as tall as sf-input, sf-button and sf-button-icon of the size (28 / 32 / 40 / 48 / 56 on a desktop), the value on the size's text, the label, help and message a step below, the open list's rows a control of the size.

value.description: Selected machine value, or a comma-separated list of values for multiple selection.

type.description: Legacy name for appearance, still honoured. See contracts/public-api-axes.json.

options.description: Options given as data instead of as sf-list-item children: [{text, value, type?, size?, icon?, selected?, disabled?, colorClass?, avatarImageUrl?, avatarTitle?, ariaLabel?, group?}]. A string or a number is taken as both the label and the value. A parent that renders this dropdown from a template passes its options this way, because capturing child elements means removing them, and the parent can then no longer put a changed list back. Options carrying the same `group`, one after another, are drawn under one heading, so a long list says where each stretch of it comes from instead of repeating that in every row.

inherited-value.description: The option value (values joined by commas when several may be chosen) the field falls back to while nothing is chosen. Its options' labels are shown as inherited, in the placeholder's ink with an «inherited» marker, never as a choice: the form value stays empty. Once something is chosen, a reset button returns it here. Select mode; a tag-mode field does not draw it.

inherited-text.description: The words of the marker shown while the inherited value applies. Unset, it follows the page's language («inherited», «наследуется»).

reset-label.description: The accessible name of the button that returns the field to the inherited value. Unset, it follows the page's language («Reset to inherited», «Сбросить к наследуемому»).

value.description: The value of the item chosen or cleared; "" when none.

values.description: Every selected value after the change.

item.description: The chosen option's data (text, value, type, icon, disabled, group, ...), not the sf-list-item element; null when a value was cleared.

root.description: The emitting sf-dropdown, the live element (the detail is not JSON).

multiple.description: Whether several values can be selected.

openDropdown.summary: Opens the option list unless the control is disabled or already open. Returns the element.

closeDropdown.summary: Closes the option list and clears the search text. Returns the element.

toggleDropdown.summary: Closes the list when open, opens it otherwise. Returns the element.

setError.summary: Show an error message and the invalid state, or clear both with an empty message. Writes error-message and invalid and sets the custom error the form will not submit over. Returns the element.

resetToInherited.summary: Returns the field to its inherited value, as the reset button does: fires the cancellable sf-field-reset, then empties the own value and focuses the control. Returns whether it was reset (false without an inherited value, without an own value, while disabled or readonly, or when the event was prevented).

change.summary: The selection changed; dispatched on the host. The name to bind.

sf-field-reset.summary: The person pressed the reset back to the inherited value. The event of the trait field-inherit@1: one name for every field of the family, so a form hears them all at once and tells them apart by detail.tag. Fired before the field is emptied and cancellable: preventDefault keeps the value. When it is not prevented the field empties, says so with its ordinary change, shows the inherited value again and takes focus back.

tag.description: The element that was reset, as a tag name.

value.description: The field's own value before the reset.

inheritedValue.description: The inherited value it returns to.

name.description: The form name, empty when the field has none.

sf-dropdown:change.summary: Legacy name for change, still emitted with the same detail; bind change.

sf-field:reset.summary: The person pressed the reset back to the inherited value. Fired before the field is emptied and cancellable: preventDefault keeps the value. When it is not prevented the field empties, says so with its ordinary change, shows the inherited value again and takes focus back.

value.description: The field's own value before the reset.

inheritedValue.description: The inherited value it returns to.

name.description: The form name, empty when the field has none.

accessibility.focus: The toggle is the primary Tab stop. Arrow keys open and move through available options; Home and End move within the list, PageDown and PageUp by what it shows, and typed letters to the option they begin; the focused option is brought into view; Enter or Space selects; Escape closes and restores the toggle; Tab closes and continues native traversal. The searchbox keeps native text-editing Home and End behavior. After a reset back to the inherited value, focus returns to the control; while the value is inherited, the control carries it as aria-description and the visible marker is aria-hidden.

changes: portal is on by default: the list is positioned by SF.Position (Floating UI) in the native top layer, flips above near the bottom and stays inside the viewport.
portal="false" keeps the previous in-flow list.

ai_guidance.use_when: Use sf-dropdown when a form needs one or several values from a concealed option set. Use direct sf-list-item children with stable machine values and visible labels. Use portal only when an ancestor clips the popup.
do_not: Do not copy generated ui-smart code
Do not move host data or access decisions into the component
Do not use the visible label as the submitted value when a stable machine identifier exists
Do not make decorative checkbox, avatar or icon content independently focusable inside an option
ai_guidance.minimal_example: <sf-dropdown label="Статус" name="status" placeholder="Выберите статус"><sf-list-item value="open" text="Открыт"></sf-list-item><sf-list-item value="done" text="Готов"></sf-list-item></sf-dropdown>
